title: Solenta'nın Çocukları
author: Esat Zorkirişçi
description: Once upon a time, Solenta was a land of light and sunshine. Then the sun disappeared, silence descended, fog settled in, and colors faded. In a world where smiling, thinking, and singing are forbidden, people become trapped inside their own shadows. After many years, hope appears through the roots of a tree, the memory of a seed, and the whisper of a mother. Through a hidden garden, living trees, inherited memories, and quiet acts of courage, The Children of Solenta asks whether growing up means forgetting or remembering.
